tooltip.yanscriptures.covenant_codex.hin: Hold Shift to view the Twelve Authorities
tooltip.yanscriptures.covenant_codex.scr: §8(Hold Shift + scroll wheel to page through)
tooltip.yanscriptures.covenant_codex.pow: §6[War Ceases Among Nations]
§7"The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid."
§7No flesh shall lift a blade against you; even he that has the power of death knows your name.
§6[Covenant of Immortality]
§7"Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth."
§7You are struck, yet not unto death; you shall lie down, and you shall rise again.
§6[The Sun Stands Still]
§7"And the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day."
§7You open your mouth and heaven and earth hold their breath; all things halt between one thought and the next.
§6[Seven Bowls Poured]
§7"And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air, and a great voice came out of the temple, saying: It is done."
§7You raise your hand and seven plagues come upon the earth; not one that stands against you is spared.
§6[Untouchable]
§7"I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee."
§7Blades break upon you, poison stops before your feet; those who harm you eat their own fruit.
§6[Gift of Deuteronomy]
§7"Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse."
§7You lay on hands and life flows out; you lay on hands and judgement falls.
§6[Rock of Hosts]
§7"The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer."
§7Standing before the host, your shield cannot be broken nor your authority taken; your wounds, none can spare.
§6[The Resurrection and the Life]
§7"I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live."
§7The gates of hell shall not prevail against it; your death has been written into resurrection.
§6[Covenant of Hosts]
§7"Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel."
§7Each battle you win adds another measure of authority, until all hosts bow before you.
§6[Five Loaves and Two Fishes]
§7"And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full."
§7What you receive shall exceed what you asked; nothing that falls to the ground shall be lost.
§6[Pillar of Cloud and Fire]
§7"He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people."
§7When danger comes you have already been moved away; the enemy reaches out and grasps only wind.
§6[Sanctuary]
§7"I will dwell among them, and walk among them; and I will be their God."
§7Those beside you are spared the calamity; the wounds you take, you take for them.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.shema.verse: "Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD." — Deuteronomy 6:4
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.shema.desc: This scroll answers to the first commandment, "One". Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.silence.ver: "They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not... They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them." — Psalm 115:5-8
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.silence.des: This scroll answers to the second commandment, "No Images". Those who trust in the voiceless become like it.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.thorns.vers: "And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM." — Exodus 3:14
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.thorns.desc: This scroll answers to the third commandment, "The Holy Name". The name appeared in the fire; it shall not be taken in vain.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.sabbath.ver: "And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work." — Genesis 2:2
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.sabbath.des: This scroll answers to the fourth commandment, "Sabbath". Even the Creator rested from his work.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.rebellion.v: "I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me." — Isaiah 1:2
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.rebellion.d: This scroll answers to the fifth commandment, "Honour". Those who were raised turn on those who raised them.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.blood.verse: "The voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground." — Genesis 4:10
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.blood.desc: This scroll answers to the sixth commandment, "Thou shalt not kill". A voice in the ground speaks for the dead.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.harp.verse: "How shall we sing the LORD's song in a strange land?" — Psalm 137:4
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.harp.desc: This scroll answers to the seventh commandment, "Faithfulness". The harp hangs by the river; the song is not given to strangers.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.shinar.vers: "I coveted them, and took them." — Joshua 7:21
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.shinar.desc: This scroll answers to the eighth commandment, "Thou shalt not steal". What was taken was burned together with the tent.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.tongue.vers: "The tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things... and the tongue is a fire." — James 3:5-6
